result.summary:
I wrote one group spec (77,858 bytes, pure ASCII, LF) covering all four units. All four stay SAFE and there is one new flag, ENABLE_BEHAVIOR_PROFILE_EVENT_DATA.

D16b: the operator ingest gets a captured_at field validator. A captured_at later than now + kb_serve.FUTURE_SKEW_SECONDS (300 s) is refused with the existing 422 VALIDATION_ERROR (the G4 contract already uses it for a bad field), so no new code is needed. kb_serve.classify and the coverage freshness/age readings treat a timestamp beyond the skew as unknown. At base, a future last_seen grades fresh and, being the newest, is the price served.

D17b: _paged gets .order("id"); every paged relation has an id primary key (measured in 045 and 002). The host pipeline gets the live_robots exec/execute fallback. Measured on the pinned venv: upstash-redis 1.7.0 Pipeline.execute(command) only queues a command, so exec must be preferred; redis-py 8.1.0 has only execute.

D22c (1), deviation from the brief: the measured M22 record CR-DATA-MIGRATIONS-05 shows the comparisons select (category_used, products) also hits missing columns (42703), and it runs FIRST. Repointing only the user_events select would leave the profile write dead in production. The spec therefore repoints both selects under the new flag, using the house JSON-path alias idiom already used by cron_learning, and pins flag OFF with a three-scenario golden. Measured: no client file emits tab_switch, so after a flip the weights do not move; the scoring_method label becomes behavioral for profiled users while ENABLE_BEHAVIORAL_DIM_TRANSLATION is OFF.

D22c (2): the varhint dead block and the data file are deleted, with E1 removing the b3b fixture from 13 test signatures. The expected corpus SHA is the G3 value 6013...a1ef, because price_service has not changed since then.

D22d: _read_by gets paged id-ordered reads per 100-id chunk. Each unclean kb_feedback field-name row counts in dropped_deidentify (E2: GR6 changes from 0 to 6). Control characters in product names are escaped at the three render sites.

Comm set: 691 files. I stored a base record at 6869a3e6 (382 reused from the same-sha S81-20 record, 272 reused per file under GC-9, 37 run here, all green); its failed set is 17 known environmental nodes.

Base pins run: [pyt] tag=g7spec-base-pins elapsed=25s status=FAIL rc=1 (2 failed, 801 passed; the two failures are the known CRLF hygiene rows d16 r10 and d17 r9, the same as in the stored record).

open_questions: Q-D22c-1 (deviation D-1): the brief names only the user_events select, but the measured M22 record CR-DATA-MIGRATIONS-05 shows the comparisons select (category_used, products) also fails with 42703, and it runs first. The spec repoints both selects under the one flag. Accept this, or split the comparisons repoint into its own unit?
Q-D22c-2: keep the flag name ENABLE_BEHAVIOR_PROFILE_EVENT_DATA, or use ENABLE_BEHAVIOR_PROFILE_REBUILD (the M22 proposal), which better describes a change to both selects?
Q-D16b-1: confirm the 300 s skew allowance.
Q-D22d-1: should unclean kb_gaps field names also count in dropped_deidentify? The spec defaults to no.
D22d mutant M7 (a _render that also escapes a backslash) is equivalent on the current world, since no base name contains a backslash; a ruling is needed.
The corpus gate base SHA has not been re-run here; the expected value 6013...a1ef is inferred because price_service.py has not changed since G3 measured it. The RED agent re-measures it.
